name: ingest_intel
description: Load files from the intel knowledge folder into memory. Use for 'ingest my intel', 'load intel files into memory', or after manage_intel writes. Processes .txt and .md; skips files already ingested. Does not create or edit intel files; use manage_intel for that.

async.description: If true, start ingestion in background and return immediately (no wait for completion). Use for workflows where you don't need to verify ingestion succeeded.
